title: Measure the whole task-sync cycle on a coherent copy of the live Engram store (1,631 tasks)
outcome: Measure task-sync exchange lookup and decode costs on a coherent copy of the live store
acceptance: An authorized coherent-copy measurement reports source/build and copy provenance, object counts, query plans, lookup and decode costs separately, including clearly labeled representative B fixtures. Measurements do not query or alter the live store beyond coherent capture, disclose task/private content, or claim a synthetic result proves production performance.

Whole-cycle wall times on that copy, each phase separately (export; git add, commit and push or fetch through a local bare repository; import dry run; real import; repeat-import no-op), for: (a) a first full exchange into an empty store; (b) an incremental exchange with 5 changed tasks into a replica; (c) the same incremental exchange in the reverse direction. Each phase has an exact command, build and host; runs are repeated 3 times, reporting median and max. The copy stays on its host under target/ and is deleted after the measurement; only numbers and command lines are recorded.
The two-active-store (model A) cycle is measured the same way once model A is integrated, and is reported as not yet measurable until then.
